title: A lead who is no longer a technician still shows as the lead everywhere
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in In Progress, led by staff member A, with staff member A's Technician then switched off (and the warning saved), so the lead is no longer a technician.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Reload the Board View page.
  2. In the display switcher, pick "Tech View".
  3. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A still has a column, holding work order 1's card.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A still has a group, holding work order 1.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 shows staff member A as its lead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R7: “A work order's current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 still shows as the lead on the work order and in Board View and Tech View. In the Lead Technician dropdown they are listed last, grayed out, with the check mark, and cannot be picked. Picking someone else saves at once, as today, and the former lead then leaves the dropdown.”
  • S3-E1: “Someone who is not a technician but still leads a work order shown on the board keeps a column (Board View) or group (Tech View) for that work until it is reassigned or closed.”
  • S3-R2: “Board View gives a column, and Tech View a group, to each person offered by S3-R1, plus everyone who leads work shown on the board (S3-E1, S3-E2).”
  • S2-R5: “Saving with Technician off unassigns nothing. Every lead and labor line stays as it was (Story 3, S3-R7 and S3-R8).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View", picture "Board View" (This build); page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Lead Technician" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p5-02-after-board-view.png
  • tt-p6-02-after-lead-technician.png

The design's own words:

  • “No column for her: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. A column only appears for staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on.”
  • “Someone whose Technician is turned off but who still leads open work keeps a column for that work, so nothing they lead disappears from the board.”
  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. The list holds only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on.”
  • “A current lead who is not a technician any more stays the lead, listed last, grayed out with the check, so the current lead never reads as blank (PRD S3-R7).”

A former technician lead is described, not drawn: the after pictures have no lead (register TT-N07).
